findings.highlight: Well, I'm doing just fine. If anything, I'm safer now then I've ever been before.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなの全然普通じゃんか。それで危ないってんなら、今までずっと危なかったよ俺は
findings.governingReading: He calls those incidents ordinary and argues that, if they mean danger, he has been in danger all along.
findings.explanation: Normalizing longstanding hazards becomes claiming unprecedented current safety.

findings.highlight: safer now then I've ever been before.

findings.governingReading: The authored English makes an explicit safer comparison.
findings.explanation: The comparison uses then instead of than.
